title: the completion staging hint does not reach --json callers; a machine-readable field is a contract change needing an operator A/B first
description:
Found while implementing QCLI-311 (opum-ai/quest-cli#419), and deliberately NOT STARTED. The QCLI-311 hint rides the human surface only (plain and pretty text output), because the ruling of 2026-09-29 named a machine-readable field in the --json output as a contract-surface change that must come back as an A/B rather than ship in that slice. The consequence, stated plainly: most fleet sessions call quest with --json, so they never see the hint at the moment it matters; the guide is what reaches them today.

READ THIS BEFORE PICKUP: this is NOT execution. Adding a field to task.completed data (for example a stagingHint string, or the record staged paths as an array) changes the success envelope payload, which is a contract surface. It requires an operator A/B routed through opum-agent before any pickup (opum-agent OPAG-722 is the routing convention for operator-bound questions). Do not start, branch, or land it until that A/B returns.

Constraints any implementation must satisfy, all measurable in this repository today:
1. Envelope key ORDER is load-bearing: contractVersion at exact index 1 and principal last are both asserted by opum-cli-e2e harness checks over every read and mutating family. An additive key INSIDE data does not move them; a new TOP-LEVEL key must go after data and before principal.
2. test/qcli311-completion-staging-hint.test.ts currently pins the exact top-level key order [schemaVersion, contractVersion, kind, data, principal]; changing that pin deliberately is the point of the A/B, not something to edit silently.
3. Before any shape change, sweep consumers in the two passes the repository profile describes (bare field-name grep, then command-invocation grep, reading what each caller does with the response) and state the pattern matched.

Evidence: PR opum-ai/quest-cli#419, and the boundary sentence in QCLI-311 implementation notes. Filed by opum-agent instruction 2026-09-29 so the question is owned rather than living only in a message.
